elements.element: Customer has no non-compete or field-of-use restriction.
elements.evidence: Section 12.4 is absent, and §12.3 expressly states that nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service or conducting business in any field or territory; it also confirms no non-compete commitment.

elements.element: The restriction covers only a named competing product.
elements.evidence: No restriction exists in the rendered clause, so there is no operative restriction limited to a named competing product.

elements.element: The restriction applies during the term only.
elements.evidence: No operative restriction or term-limited duration is included.

elements.element: The restriction lasts no longer than 12 months.
elements.evidence: No operative restriction with a duration cap is included.

elements.element: The restriction permits Customer's internal development.
elements.evidence: Section 12.3 expressly provides that nothing restricts Customer from developing any product or service.
Section 12.3 expressly provides that nothing restricts Customer from acquiring any product or service.
